meta.name: bid-strategy-planner
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "pick a bid strategy", "set a tCPA/tROAS target", or "plan the learning-phase entry"; produces a bid-strategy choice (tCPA / tROAS / max-conversions / manual CPC), the starting target math, a portfolio grouping map, and a learning-phase entry plan. Not for splitting the budget across campaigns — use budget-optimizer; not for in-flight pacing/scale moves — use budget-pacing-monitor; not for scoring the account — use ad-account-auditor. 出价策略/tCPA目标/tROAS/学习期

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为广告活动选择最优出价策略并规划学习期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在管理广告账户，需要科学选择出价策略并设定目标。
copy.tagline_en: Choose the optimal bid strategy for your ad campaigns and plan the learning phase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage ad accounts and need to scientifically select bid strategies and set targets.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的广告系列目标、转化历史（CPA/ROAS 和转化量），推荐出价策略（tCPA、tROAS、最大化转化次数或人工每次点击费用），计算起始目标，规划组合出价组合和学习期进入方案。
howto.when: 当你要求“选择出价策略”、“设置 tCPA/tROAS 目标”或“规划学习期进入”时触发。

say.text: 设置起始 tROAS 目标：历史 ROAS 3.8 倍，目标 4.5 倍。
say.note: Claude 会计算并标注数据来源。

say.text: 把这 4 个搜索广告系列组成一个组合出价，并规划学习期进入。
say.note: Claude 会生成组合映射和学习期计划。

howto.what_en: Claude recommends a bid strategy (tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, or manual CPC) based on your campaign goal and conversion history (CPA/ROAS and volume), calculates the starting target, and produces a portfolio grouping map and a learning-phase entry plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "pick a bid strategy", "set a tCPA/tROAS target", or "plan the learning-phase entry".

say_en.text: Pick a bid strategy for this campaign: DR goal, past 30 days $42 CPA, 90 conversions/mo.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a strategy with rationale.

say_en.text: Set a starting tROAS target: history is 3.8x ROAS, goal is 4.5x.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate and label data sources.

say_en.text: Group these 4 search campaigns into a bid portfolio and plan the learning-phase entry.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a portfolio map and entry plan.
